ecology.config.title: Ecology
ecology.config.mode.tooltip:
Fog tint: fade the seafloor into water fog from above. Needs Fabulous.
Opaque: make far water less transparent. No Fabulous needed.
Off: vanilla water.
ecology.config.iris.tooltip: Turns Ecology water effects off while an Iris pack is running.
ecology.config.warn_fabulous.tooltip: Chat reminder if Fog tint is on without Fabulous / Improved Transparency.
ecology.config.looking.tooltip: From above water: hide the pale basin outline and fade the seafloor into fog. Needs Fabulous.
ecology.config.looking.horizon.tooltip: How strongly distant water picks up the same white air fog as land.
ecology.config.looking.fill.tooltip: How hard the seafloor fades into water fog, and how hard empty sky behind water is filled.
ecology.config.looking.darkness.tooltip: Darkens the biome water fog used for fill. 0 = biome color, 1 = black.
ecology.config.looking.use_percent.toolt: On: Start and End are a percent of render distance. Off: they are blocks.
ecology.config.looking.start_percent.too: Percent of render distance where fill begins. Always below End.
ecology.config.looking.end_percent.toolt: Percent of render distance where fill is full.
ecology.config.looking.start_blocks.tool: Blocks from the camera where fill begins. Close water stays clear.
ecology.config.looking.end_blocks.toolti: Blocks from the camera where fill is full. Always at least Start + 1.
ecology.config.swim.custom_fog.tooltip: Replace vanilla’s short underwater fog with the distances below. Brightness still applies if this is off.
ecology.config.swim.fade.tooltip: Seconds to blend view distance when you swim into a different water type. 0 = instant.
ecology.config.swim.light.tooltip: Vanilla oceans go cave-dark after about 15 blocks of water above you.
ecology.config.swim.bright_until.tooltip: Blocks of water overhead before extra brightness starts fading.
ecology.config.swim.dark_at.tooltip: Blocks of water overhead where extra brightness is gone. Always at least Bright until + 1.
ecology.config.swim.distance.tooltip: How far you can see while underwater, in blocks. Does not scale with render distance.
ecology.config.swim.cold.tooltip: Frozen Ocean, Sympagic Zone, Cold Ocean, Cold Eelgrass.
ecology.config.swim.temperate.tooltip: Ocean, Seagrass Meadow, Temperate Rocky Reef, Sand Wave Field.
ecology.config.swim.lukewarm.tooltip: Lukewarm Ocean, Subtropical Seagrass, Patch Reef, Soft Coral Garden.
ecology.config.swim.deep_basin.tooltip: Fairly clean, but dark — vis dies from light, not silt.
ecology.config.swim.warm.tooltip: Warm Ocean, Coral Reef, Tropical Seagrass.
ecology.config.swim.open_ocean.tooltip: Upper pelagic. Drops to Deep Basin when you go deeper.
ecology.config.swim.other.tooltip: Rivers, lakes, and anything not listed above.
ecology.config.opaque.tooltip: Fallback that makes far water less see-through. No Fabulous needed. Ignored while Mode is Fog tint.
ecology.config.opaque.distance.tooltip: Fade water toward opaque with distance.
ecology.config.opaque.strength.tooltip: At End: 1 = fully opaque from this group alone.
ecology.config.opaque.start.tooltip: Where the fade begins, as a fraction of render distance. 0 = at the camera.
ecology.config.opaque.end.tooltip: Where the fade reaches full strength. Must be at least Start.
ecology.config.opaque.angle.tooltip: Extra opacity when looking across the water.
ecology.config.opaque.curve.tooltip: Lower = more angles get opaque. Higher = only near the horizon.
ecology.config.debug.logging.tooltip: Log distant-water status and print a short summary to chat when config applies.
ecology.config.debug.translucent.tooltip: Paint ice, glass, and water cyan. If nothing changes, Ecology’s terrain shader is not running.
ecology.config.debug.fog_fill.tooltip: Pink where Fog tint fill is applying. Needs Fabulous.
ecology.config.debug.marked.tooltip: Yellow = near, blue = far. Underwater stays faint.
ecology.config.chat.load_failed: Ecology: failed to load config, using defaults (see log)
ecology.config.chat.save_failed: Ecology: failed to save config (see log)
ecology.config.chat.fabulous: Ecology Fog tint needs Improved Transparency (Fabulous graphics). Enable it in Video Settings, or switch Mode to Opaque / Off. You can disable this reminder in Ecology → General.
ecology.config.chat.debug_on: Ecology debug ON — yellow→blue=distance, green→red=angle, pink=behind-water Fog tint (Fabulous), cyan=any translucent.
ecology.config.chat.pack_failed: Ecology: failed to write shader settings pack (see log)
